verified_facts.text: The hotel is in Perth's east end, towering over Hibernian Place, a short stroll from the city's shopping, business, dining and cultural hub.
verified_facts.excerpt: Positioned in the city's east end and towering over idyllic Hibernian Place, The Westin Perth is a short stroll from Perth's shopping, business, dining and cultural hub.

verified_facts.text: Elizabeth Quay, Kings Park, the Art Gallery of WA and the nightlife of Northbridge and the CBD are a short walk away.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elizabeth Quay, Kings Park, The Art Gallery of WA and the bustling Perth city nightlife in Northbridge and the Perth CBD, are only a short walk away

verified_facts.text: Hibernian Place, with its cafes and restaurants, is on the hotel's doorstep.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hibernian Place is home to cafes and restaurants on the doorstop of The Westin Perth.

verified_facts.text: The outdoor pool is on level 5, with a heated outdoor rain shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dive into a complete sense of serenity on level 5 of our hotel with an outdoor pool in Perth and finish with a rejuvenating heated outdoor rain shower.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is home to BODHI Westin, a holistic wellness spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: BODHI Westin is a stand-out holistic wellness destination, set in the five-star surrounds of The Westin Perth.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows that bring in natural light.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ceiling to floor windows enhance natural light.

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite is on the top floor, with a balcony, sauna, separate lounge, dining area and kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: a top floor location, spectacular views of the surrounding suburbs of Perth, a balcony, sauna, separate lounge, dining, kitchen

verified_facts.text: Westin Executive suites have floor-to-ceiling windows with city views, a separate lounge and dining room, and Club Lounge access.
verified_facts.excerpt: soak in scenic city views from the spacious Westin Executive suites which boast floor-to-ceiling windows

verified_facts.text: The Westin Club Lounge offers breakfast, evening drinks and canapes, and all-day use with tea, coffee and refreshments.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Westin Club Lounge offers daily benefits including breakfast, evening drinks and canapés, and use of the lounge throughout the day with complimentary tea, coffee and refreshments.

verified_facts.text: Club Lounge evening drinks and canapes are for guests 18 and over; children are welcome at other times.
verified_facts.excerpt: Drinks & canapes are available for guests 18+years 5pm-7pm. Children welcome all other times.

verified_facts.text: Garum is a Roman osteria by chef Guy Grossi, housed in historic Hibernian Hall.
verified_facts.excerpt: our Roman Osteria, a collaboration between Guy Grossi and The Westin Perth, housed in the stunning surrounds of historic Hibernian Hall

verified_facts.text: Haven Lounge serves a seasonal High Tea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step into the elegant surrounds of Haven Lounge and enjoy our seasonal High Tea.

verified_facts.text: The Westin Workout Fitness Studio has TRX functional training equipment.
The hotel has a Strava running map with a running route through Perth city.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take advantage of The Westin Perth Strava running map with a comprehensive running route throughout the Perth city

verified_facts.text: Every room has a Westin Heavenly Bed.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sleep well in our large hotel rooms in Perth with the signature Westin Heavenly® Bed
